Armoured cable discount, supply markup & wastage

We buy armoured cable at 75% off list and quote at +35%. A 4-core aluminium armoured cable lists at Rs 1,217/m, is quoted at Rs 411/m and costs us Rs 319/m. The wastage is 5% of cable bought and not billed - offcuts and pulling losses. It raises our cost.
We buy glands at 50% off list and quote at +45%. A 2-core armoured aluminium gland lists at Rs 203.75, is quoted at Rs 147.72 and costs us Rs 101.88.
A stored cable install cost is billed at double. A 4-core copper armoured cable's Rs 22/m install cost is billed at Rs 44/m.
Point Wiring, Wiring, Cabling & Termination (2 uses)
We buy lugs at 40% off list and quote at +55%. A 4-core unarmoured aluminium lug lists at Rs 71.66, is quoted at Rs 60.19 and costs us Rs 43.00.
The rods, channels and bolts a ceiling-mounted tray needs. A 10 m ceiling run adds Rs 1,060; a floor run adds nothing.

Cutting the floor, when asked for. A 10 m cut adds Rs 2,000.
Refilling a floor trench, when asked for. A 10 m trench adds Rs 1,800.
The margin on the floor-cutting charge. Rs 200/m of cutting is billed at Rs 290/m.

The margin on a cable tray's supply rate. A Ladder, MS powder-coated tray at Rs 290/m is quoted at Rs 420.50/m.
We buy conduit at 50% off list and quote at +40%. A PVC 32 mm conduit lists at Rs 100/m, is quoted at Rs 70/m and costs us Rs 50/m.

An LMS catalogue rate is our cost with nothing added. The Rs 24,500 Lutron panel costs us Rs 24,500. Raise this and every LMS cost rises.

what it does, with an example
derived from the pricing rules - read only
24G aluminium cladding sheet, per sq.m of sheet. Read by the 24G cladding options.
26G aluminium cladding sheet, per sq.m of sheet. Read by the 26G cladding options.
Aluminium sheet is cut with an overlap, so 1 sq.m of pipe surface consumes 1.25 sq.m of sheet. Applies to the aluminium sheet only -- never to the glass cloth.
The depth a per-number cross-talk is assumed to have: 2 x (W + H) x this / 10^6 sq.m of the per-sq.m rate. Read by ADP's per-number cross-talk rule.
The standard length of one piece of flexible duct: a per-number row is the per-metre rate x this. Read by ADP's per-number flexible duct rule.
Fabrication added per sq.m of GI framework cladding, on top of the sheet.
Perforated GI sheet for the framework cladding, per sq.m. Its own input, NOT the aluminium rate: the two happen to be equal today and must be able to move apart.
The share of a sq.m of GI sheet one sq.m of framework cladding consumes.
Glass cloth, per sq.m. Read on its own (glass cloth with paint) and added to an aluminium sheet on the 'with Glass Cloth' options.
Added to a per-number mixing box / LP plenum's SUPPLY cost, before the round-up and the supply markup; never to install. Read by ADP's per-number mixing box rule.
The accessories share on a CPVC pipe's BCS cost (the sheet's 'BCS Accessories' column): supply = ROUNDUP(BCS pipe x (1 + this)) before the supply markup. Read by the CPVC per-metre pipeline only.
The accessories share on a Copper pipe's BCS cost (the sheet's 'BCS Accessories' column): supply = ROUNDUP(BCS pipe x (1 + this)) before the supply markup. Read by the Copper per-metre pipeline only.
The accessories share on a MS pipe's BCS cost (the sheet's 'BCS Accessories' column): supply = ROUNDUP(BCS pipe x (1 + this)) before the supply markup. Read by the MS per-metre pipeline only.
The accessories share on a PVC pipe's BCS cost (the sheet's 'BCS Accessories' column): supply = ROUNDUP(BCS pipe x (1 + this)) before the supply markup. Read by the PVC per-metre pipeline only.
